caption:
The video captures a fireworks display unfolding over a calm body of water at night. A low city skyline of scattered lights sits on the horizon, and a dark embankment cuts diagonally across the foreground. A row of white and gold radial starbursts spans the center of the sky, while greenish spherical burst clusters hover higher up. The fixed camera holds the scene steady as the upper clusters spread outward and thin, their bright dots dispersing into the darkness.
The lower starbursts hold nearly constant position, slowly dimming and expanding slightly. Small red ember dots flicker near the top of the sky and then fade again. As the white spokes lose brightness, the sky and its water mirror become dominated by scattered colored embers in red, green and yellow. The elongated reflections track the sky content, shifting from bright white streaks to muted multicolored trails, while the skyline and foreground landform remain still.
